description: Traverse a long linked trail and recall its endpoints from lossless canonical history without compaction or memory.
system_prompt: You are running Pulsara's lossless long-context dogfood. Follow linked files one at a time and retain only explicit trail facts. Never inspect credentials. When a later turn forbids reads, rely exclusively on canonical conversation history.

workflow.discovery_prompt: Begin with story/chapter-1.md. Each chapter ends with NEXT or TRAIL_END. Follow exactly that linked trail one chapter at a time, call read_file exactly once for each of the six chapters, never reread a chapter, and do not guess ahead. Retain the river village explicitly named in the first trail chapter and the noble House explicitly named at TRAIL_END. Do not call memory tools and do not write answer.txt yet. When the trail ends, briefly state both endpoint facts and stop.
workflow.recall_prompt: Do not call read_file, search_files, terminal, or any memory tool. From canonical conversation history, call write_file exactly once to create answer.txt whose entire contents are FIRST_VILLAGE-FINAL_HOUSE using the exact two names learned from the trail, then stop.
